        x = (R[2, 1] - R[1, 2]) / S
        y = (R[0, 2] - R[2, 0]) / S

    elif (R[0, 0] > R[1, 1]) and (R[0, 0] > R[2, 2]):

        y = (R[1, 2] + R[2, 1]) / S
